{{Quote|Five days ago the Empire attacked one of our secret bases in the city of Talay.|[[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]]|<ref name="DF">''[[Star Wars: Dark Forces]]''</ref>}}
'''Talay''' was a small [[city/Legends|city]] on the [[planet/Legends|planet]] [[Talay/Legends|Talay]]. Nearby was [[Tak Base]], a secret installation of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="Strongholds" /> It was devastated by the [[Dark Trooper Project]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="DF" />

==Description==
The city of Talay was a small settlement on the planet of the same name, built near a river. It consisted of some small buildings and a [[cantina/Legends|cantina]] to the south. The settlement was powered by a [[hydroelectric power generator]] situated on a pond of the river in the back side of the cantina.<ref name="guide">''[[Dark Forces Official Player's Guide]]''</ref>

Another pond separated the city of Talay from the [[Tak Base]] area. A rotating bridge, operated from a control room in the middle of the pond, connected the room either towards the settlement or towards the base.<ref name="guide" />

==History==
Several months after the [[Evacuation of Yavin]], Tak Base became the target of the first demonstration of the [[Dark Trooper/Legends|dark trooper]] project. [[Dark Trooper hyperspace capsule|Hyperspace capsules]] sent these new [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] troopers to various locations of the planet and [[Attack on Tak Base|quickly wiped out]] many civilians in the siege against the base.<ref name="DF" />

The massacre mobilized the Rebellion, and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Kyle Katarn]] was sent by [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] to [[Mission to Talay|investigate]]. The ''[[Moldy Crow/Legends|Moldy Crow]]'' piloted by [[Jan Ors]] dropped Katarn on a courtyard somewhere in the city, but the first thing he saw was the ruined settlement, its ground scattered with dead burnt bodies, the result of the massacre. The whole city was now "inhabited" by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] who secured the place. Initially, he saw that the whole area was devoid of power. Defending himself from the stormtroopers, he managed to reach and restart the hydroelectric [[Power generator/Legends|power generator]].<ref name="DF" />

With power now activated, he was able to operate the rotating bridge which connected the city with the Tak Base. Once he collected the [[Imperial repeater rifle|evidence]] he needed, he traced his way back; although the Empire had sent reinforcements with fresh troops,<ref name="guide" /> he reached the courtyard, and left on his ship.<ref name="DF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Talay, both the city and the planet first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: Dark Forces]]''. In a cutscene, [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] referred to it as the "City of Talay", which indicates that "Talay" might have meant to be the name of the city. The ''Dark Forces'' script, also mentions the "home planet of the city of Talay".<ref name="guide" />
